pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit, Cozio Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a Nc3-d1-e3 route with the queen on d1; plan 1 called the f-file open. Rewrote plans 1-2 (Nf3 against the queen, d4 and Bxf4); British spelling in overview and plan 4.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit, Greco Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 named an f2-pawn that isn't there; plan 3 sent the king to g1, which the c5-bishop covers; plan 1 had Rg1 with the knight on g1. Rewrote all four plans.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit, Grimm Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White's impossible dxe5 (e5 is White's own pawn) and an h3-f2 knight route; plan 3 had Kg2 with the g2-pawn in place. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Bishop's Gambit, Kieseritzky Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 offered Bb3 as an alternative in a way the parser read as following Bxb5. Reworded plan 1.

pages.name: Requena Gambit, KGA
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Be2 with the king going to e2; plan 3 had ...Bg4 with the d7-pawn in the way. Rewrote plans 1-3 (4.Ke2, d4 and Nf3; ...Nc6 and ...d5).

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Cunningham Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 had g3 and Kg2 after a Kf1 not yet played; overview said ...Bh4+ forces the king to move (Nxh4 is possible). Rewrote plans 1-3 and the overview sentence; British spelling.

pages.name: KGA: Scandinavian, Modern, 5.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plans 3-4 had dxc6 and bxc6 for the wrong side and a bishop pair Black doesn't get; the first rewrite claimed Ba4 protects d5 (reviewer). Rewrote plans 3-4 (6.dxc6 Nxc6 or 6.Bc4); British spelling and half-open f-file in plans 1-2.

pages.name: KGA: Scandinavian, Modern, 5.Bb5+ c6 6.dxc6 Nxc6
pages.notes: Overview and plans spoke of White's c6-pawn and a d4-e4 duo; after 6...Nxc6 there is no c6-pawn and White has no e-pawn. Rewrote overview and all four plans (material level, Black keeps f4, ...Bd6 and ...Bg4).

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Abbazia Defense
pages.notes: Plan 4 named bare e4 and f5; plan 2 offered Bb5+ as support for d5, which it isn't (reviewer). Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Double Muzio Gambit, Baldwin Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 listed a c4-bishop that Black has just captured. Rewrote plan 1 (Nd5, d3 hitting the queen, Bxf4); British spelling in overview and plans 2-3.
